{{Otheruses|Battle sense}}
'''Battle sense''' was a [[Ta-Ree]] spell capable of being wielded by [[Ascendant (Kathol)|Ascendants]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. Ascendants using battle sense were more focused and concentrated in combat situations. To the Ascendant, opponents became mentally highlighted making them easier to attack or defend against, knowing when to make the right move during a fight. The wielder was required to know the [[detect life]] and [[sense danger]] Ta-Ree spells to learn the battle sense spell.<ref name="Endgame">''[[Endgame]]''</ref>
